parameters.name: filterFailedRequests
parameters.description: Specifies whether to filter out zero values.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the detailed consumption (request) records of the subject within the cycle.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of detailed consumption (request) records per page for the subject within the cycle. Maximum value: 10.

parameters.name: subjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the subject (consumer or consumer group).
